بَسَالَةٌ inf. n. of بَسُلَ, q. v. (S, M, &c.) ―
-b2- Also [i. q. بُسُولٌ, inf. n. of بَسَلَ, q. v.; meaning] A frowning, contracting the face, or looking sternly or austerely or morosely; or doing so with grinning, or displaying the teeth; or contracting the part between the eyes; by reason of courage, or of anger. (Ham p. 14.) ―
-b3- And dislike, disapprobation, displeasure, or hatred. (Ham ibid.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
